in_marathi.name: Gobhil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of knowledge and power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gobhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gobhil is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Gobh' meaning 'God' and 'Il' meaning 'knowledge' or 'power'. This name signifies the divine being who embodies knowledge and power.
